note: s44's DETERMINISTIC gates — the only bench numbers allowed to fail a PR (D5). Everything wall-derived (ns/op, speedups, geomeans, the X3 delta, the sentinel delta, LLVM's wall share) is report-only and lives in the nightly report JSON. `cargo xtask bench-gates` recomputes these and fails on regression.

ir_volume.why_not_a_hard_gate: The contract (#70 metric 1) budgets the LLVM IR handed to LLVM at <= 50% of the naive s41 lowering. Measured at s44: 57.7% over the corpus, 87.5% over the 13 hot kernels. Asserting 0.50 today would make every commit red without telling anyone anything new, so the gate is a RATCHET at the measured value plus slack, and the shortfall is reported as an open item (see bench/loss-ledger.md, gap G1). Tighten the ceiling whenever the mid-end earns it; the contract target stays recorded here so nobody forgets what it was.

vectorization_witnesses.note: report 10 delta 2. Deterministic, so it gates: a loop that stops vectorizing fails here before wall time moves on the current machine. `wolf` counts remarks from `clang -x ir -O2` on the module the backend actually emits; `c_naive` from `clang -O3` on ref.c. A wolf count of 0 across the board is the s44 finding, not the s44 target — the floors are recorded so the first kernel that starts vectorizing is visible, and so one that stops again is a red gate.
